raw_response:
This small plot of mine is just 0.08 hectares — barely a corner of my land. I have it intercropped with another crop because here in Mtwara the soil is sandy and tires quickly, so mixing helps. I do not have money to waste on chemical fertilizer for such a small plot, and the rains we get from November through April should be enough — I cannot irrigate anyway. I will use seeds I saved from last season, and my wife and I will manage the work ourselves; no need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
